业务背景

  • Display & Video 360 is one of the products in Google Marketing Platform for Enterprises, which covers those audiences that cannot be reached by the main channels and maintains highly incremental value.
  • Based on Google’s powerful integration of inventory and automation, it could reach today’s always-connected audience wherever they are.
  • Shopee DV360 Team has been using DV360 UI for 2 years and due to some DV360 UI’s limitations they cannot maximise their efficiency. 
  • Suffering from the pain points in heavy dirty work, extra hours(6~8 hours per week) are needed on DV 360 channel.

相关名词解释

  • Partner：DV360 平台一级合作账号，shopee相关数据管理均在此合作账号中进行。
  • Advertiser：DV360 平台二级合作账号，实际assets 权限归属在此维度。业务层面中，不同advertiser分别管理不同market数据。
  • Campaign/Insertion Order/Line item：广告管理计划层级，可分别设置不同投放计划和策略。各层级独立管理，存在范围隶属管理。需在Line item层级绑定实际展示用且有效creative后，完成所有广告配置。
  • Creative assignment：将已有creative添加至Line item中，用于广告投放的行为。

同步筛选标准

  • Advertiser：该Partner下所有advertisers
  • Campaign：所有advertiser下active, paused状态的campaign（DAP需要转化为Active,Pending,Paused,End, Archived状态，下面IO和LI同理）

  • Line item：可同步IO下所有Draft, Active, Paused 状态且Type 类型为Display, Video, Mobile app install(Display/Video), Ads in mobile apps(Display/Video)的Line item
